smoke_test_anchor: RED = the package does not install / shared does not import / check_all does not run / migrate does not work. GREEN = pip install -e .[dev] passes, python -c 'import shared, stages.s01_agent_loop' works, python scripts/check_all.py exits with 0 offline and with no key, python scripts/migrate.py up && down passes against dev Postgres.

tasks.title: Package skeleton: pyproject with extras, stages/s01..s10, shared/, scripts/
tasks.dod: pip install -e .[dev] finishes successfully; python -c "import shared, stages.s01_agent_loop" does not fail; ruff check . passes; all 10 stage packages exist with an __init__.py and a readable placeholder docstring

tasks.title: The shared core: config (profiles), llm (an OpenAI-compatible shim), fake_llm, trace
tasks.dod: With APP_PROFILE=local and with NO API key at all, shared.llm.get_client() returns a deterministic FakeLLM; with LLM_BASE_URL+LLM_API_KEY set it returns an openai client with that base_url; shared.trace.step() appends a JSONL line to traces/; none of this makes a network call in the local profile

tasks.title: The test harness: scripts/check_all.py plus a smoke check that it catches a failure
tasks.dod: python scripts/check_all.py finds and runs every stages/*/check.py, prints a summary and exits with 0 offline; a deliberately broken check gives a non-zero exit code and names the stage that failed (that is the proof the harness works rather than staying silent)

tasks.title: Dev compose: Postgres with pgvector plus Redis for local development
tasks.dod: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml config is valid; docker compose up -d brings up pgvector/pgvector:pg16 and redis:7; both accept connections; the data survives a restart thanks to named volumes

tasks.title: Migrations: scripts/migrate.py plus the initial migration
tasks.dod: python scripts/migrate.py up applies 0001 (CREATE EXTENSION vector plus the schema_migrations table) against dev Postgres; python scripts/migrate.py down rolls back cleanly; a repeated up is idempotent; with no DATABASE_URL configured the command finishes with an understandable message rather than a traceback

tasks.title: CI: install + ruff + check_all, with no secrets
tasks.dod: the workflow is valid YAML; the commands match the machine keys in docs/architecture-map.md (build_cmd, test_cmd, lint_cmd); the job references no secret and passes on a clean runner with no network to an LLM provider

tasks.title: Root documents: README (UA+EN), CURRICULUM, GLOSSARY, SETUP, SECURITY, CLAUDE.md
tasks.dod: CLAUDE.md lists the conventions from docs/architecture-map.md §Conventions with no divergence; CURRICULUM.md holds all 10 stages with a status (all 'not started'), dependencies and a time estimate; SETUP.md gives a working sequence of commands from clone to a green check_all; GLOSSARY.md has a skeleton and the first stage 1 terms; SECURITY.md describes the threat model of a public endpoint
